aviation_incidents.headline: 尼泊爾聖母峰地區直升機著陸相撞，1名乘客罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 尼泊爾索盧昆布地區警方表示，11月3日兩架直升機在聖母峰地區費里切直升機停機坪著陸時相撞，造成1名乘客死亡、3人受傷。罹難者為47歲、來自印度清奈的印度籍人士；傷者包括與罹難者搭乘同一架直升機、具印度裔背景的紐西蘭籍人士，以及兩架直升機的飛行員。尼泊爾民航局表示，兩架直升機均為AS350單引擎直升機；其中，Air Dynasty Heli Service的直升機註冊編號為9N-AOD，自盧卡拉的丹增希拉蕊機場抵達，未載運乘客，而Fishtail Air的直升機註冊編號為9N-AJR，自戈拉克雪普抵達，載有2名外籍乘客。報導指出，兩架直升機的旋翼在著陸時發生碰撞。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Two helicopters collide near Mount Everest, killing passenger
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Two helicopters collided while landing at the Pheriche helipad in Nepal's Mount Everest region on November 3, 2026, killing one passenger and injuring three people, according to the Solukhumbu District Police Office. The victim was a 47-year-old Indian national from Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The injured were a New Zealand citizen of Indian origin who was traveling on the same helicopter as the victim, and the pilots of both aircraft. Nepal's Civil Aviation Authority said both aircraft were AS350 single-engine helicopters: the Air Dynasty Heli Service helicopter, registered 9N-AOD, had arrived from Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla carrying no passengers, while the Fishtail Air helicopter, registered 9N-AJR, was arriving from Gorakshep with two foreign passengers on board. The report said the helicopters' rotors struck during landing.

aviation_incidents.headline: 美軍黑鷹直升機NFL飛越表演險遭煙火擊中
aviation_incidents.summary: 2026年11月2日，美國陸軍4架UH-60M黑鷹直升機在西雅圖流明球場舉行的西雅圖海鷹對芝加哥熊NFL賽前國歌儀式中執行飛越表演。這4架直升機隸屬第16戰鬥航空旅第2-158突擊直升機營，表演吸引約7萬名觀眾入場。前3架直升機飛越球場後，球場煙火才開始施放，但第4架直升機當時仍在球場附近，煙火在其極近處爆炸，現場觀眾發出驚呼。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: US Army Black Hawk nearly struck by fireworks during NFL flyover in Seattle
aviation_incidents.summary_en: On November 2, 2026, four US Army Sikorsky UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters from the 2-158th Assault Helicopter Battalion, part of the 16th Combat Aviation Brigade, performed a ceremonial flyover at Lumen Field in Seattle as part of the national anthem ceremony ahead of the Monday Night Football matchup between the Seattle Seahawks and the Chicago Bears, which attracted approximately 70,000 spectators. According to MyNorthwest, as cited in the report, the first three helicopters passed over the stadium before the fireworks display began, but the fourth aircraft was still nearby when the stadium's pyrotechnics were activated.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 國軍少校嚴力行赴美拍攝F-22戰機，獲AIT攝影比賽首獎
taiwan_aviation.summary: 軍聞社表示，目前於國防大學理工學院研究所進修的少校嚴力行，以作品「F-22戰機」參加美國在台協會為慶祝美國建國250週年舉辦的「鏡頭下的美國」攝影比賽，獲得「美國創新」主題首獎。該比賽另設「美國故事」、「美國之美」主題，邀請民眾分享赴美旅遊的難忘影像。嚴力行表示，他在陸軍官校求學期間培養對攝影的興趣，休假時常前往拍攝飛機；今年夏天赴美旅遊期間，他特別安排參訪當地航空展，因而拍下F-22戰機飛行的珍貴畫面。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan major's F-22 photo wins first prize in AIT photography contest
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Major 嚴力行, who is currently studying at the graduate institute of National Defense University's College of Science and Engineering, won first prize in the America's Innovation theme with his photographic work F-22 Fighter Jet in the American Institute in Taiwan's Through the Lens of America photography contest, according to the Military News Agency. The contest was held to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States, with the themes American Stories, Beauty of America, and America's Innovation, inviting the public to share memorable images from travel in the United States. Yen said he developed a strong interest in photography while studying at the Republic of China Military Academy and often went to photograph aircraft during holidays; during a trip to the United States this summer, he specially arranged to visit a local airshow, giving him the opportunity to capture the F-22 in flight.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇藝術機助陣，中職聯隊11月10日搭JX800赴東京戰亞冠賽
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空表示，中職聯隊將於11月10日搭乘JX800班機前往日本東京，參加2026年亞洲職棒冠軍爭霸賽；本屆賽事將於11月12日在東京巨蛋開打。星宇航空特別安排「AIRSORAYAMA Gold空山金」藝術機執飛該班機，並邀請球迷搭乘同一班機赴日為台灣隊加油。該班機的應援主題為「Fly In GOLD! Go For Gold!」，星宇航空也為中職聯隊與該班機乘客準備應援小物，並安排具女子國家隊棒球選手身分的空服員張甄芸擔任該班機執勤組員，與全體組員一同為中職聯隊加油。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX art aircraft to fly CPBL combined team to Tokyo for Asia championship
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: STARLUX Airlines said the Chinese Professional Baseball League combined team will take flight JX800 to Tokyo, Japan, on November 10 to take part in the 2026 Asia Professional Baseball Championship, which is scheduled to begin on November 12 at Tokyo Dome. STARLUX specially arranged its AIRSORAYAMA Gold art aircraft to operate the flight and invited fans to take the same flight to cheer for Team Taiwan. The support theme for the flight is Fly In GOLD! Go For Gold!, and STARLUX prepared support items for the combined team and for passengers on the flight. STARLUX also arranged for cabin crew member 張甄芸, who holds the status of a women's national baseball player, to serve as a working crew member on the flight, joining all crew members in cheering for the combined team.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍封存3架A-29超級大嘴鳥戰機 委由SNC維護存放
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍發布公告，規劃將單一來源合約頒發給 Sierra Nevada Corporation（SNC），為已進入封存狀態的 3 架 A-29 超級大嘴鳥（Super Tucano）輕型攻擊機提供支援。這些封存於愛德華茲空軍基地的全密封型戰機，預計將不再代表美國空軍執行飛行任務。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Air Force Stores Remaining A-29 Super Tucano Fleet at Edwards AFB
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Air Force has issued a notice to award a sole-source contract to Sierra Nevada Corporation (SNC) to provide support for three A-29 Super Tucano aircraft currently placed in storage. The three fully sealed aircraft are held at Edwards Air Force Base and are not expected to return to flight operations for the service.

international_aviation.headline: ShieldAI公開自主尾坐式戰機X-BAT001首架試飛載具
international_aviation.summary: ShieldAI公開一段短片，首度展示X-BAT001，外界認為這是其自主尾坐式戰機的首架試飛載具。影片中的飛機位於機庫內，具備寬大機翼、灰色數位迷彩與醒目的引擎尾噴口，機身標示「X-BAT001」與Hivemind字樣，顯示將由Hivemind自主軟體駕駛。該機機翼大幅後掠並融入寬大的中央機身，沒有座艙或座艙罩，前機身下方還有一處寬大的口狀開口，看似為進氣口。
international_aviation.headline_en: Shield AI rolls out X-BAT 001, its autonomous tail-sitting fighter
international_aviation.summary_en: A short video shows the aircraft inside a hangar, revealing its broad wings, grey digital camouflage and prominent engine exhaust. The aircraft wears markings reading X-BAT 001 and Powered by Hivemind, identifying the vehicle and the autonomy software intended to fly it. Its sharply swept wings blend into a substantial central body, with no cockpit or canopy, and panel boundaries and fasteners are visible in closer views, alongside a broad, mouth-like opening beneath the forward body that appears to form the aircraft's intake.

international_aviation.headline: 美國航空考慮將費城旗艦貴賓室擴大近一倍
international_aviation.summary: 美國航空正在考慮最快明年3月將費城國際機場西側頭等艙貴賓室併入旗艦貴賓室，此舉可能使旗艦貴賓室空間幾乎翻倍。目前的旗艦貴賓室面積為12500平方英尺，可容納200名旅客，鄰近的西側頭等艙貴賓室面積為11000平方英尺，最多可容納181名旅客；兩間相連的貴賓室合併後，將形成25000平方英尺的綜合空間。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines considers nearly doubling Philadelphia Flagship Lounge
international_aviation.summary_en: American Airlines is considering absorbing Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)'s A West Admirals Club into its Flagship Lounge as soon as March next year, a move that could nearly double the Flagship space. The current Flagship lounge covers 12,500 square feet with capacity for 200 guests, while the neighboring A West Admirals Club covers 11,000 square feet with capacity for up to 181 guests. Merged, the two connected lounges would form a 25,000-square-foot complex.

international_aviation.headline: 美國航空重返海地，開通邁阿密至海地角每日航線
international_aviation.summary: 美國航空恢復飛往海地的航班，11月1日起開通邁阿密國際機場與海地角國際機場之間的每日直飛航線。美國航空是自2024年美國航空公司因安全疑慮停飛以來，首家恢復飛往海地服務的大型美國網絡航空公司。首航機組為全海地籍、能說克里奧爾語的機組，由奧利弗讓機長帶隊。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines returns to Haiti with daily Miami-Cap-Haitien service
international_aviation.summary_en: American Airlines has resumed flights to Haiti, launching daily nonstop service between Miami International Airport and Cap-Haitien International Airport (CAP) on November 1. The airline is the first major US network carrier to restore service to the country since US airlines suspended flights amid escalating security concerns in 2024. Its inaugural flight carried an all-Haitian, Creole-speaking crew led by Captain Oliver Jean.

international_aviation.headline: FAA下令檢查部分波音787中央油箱密封膠，防範雷擊爆炸風險
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署發布適航指令，要求檢查部分波音787-8、787-9與787-10客機。這項於2026年11月2日發布的指令針對中央翼油箱密封膠安裝，相關安裝缺乏必要的黏著測試證據，而這項問題是波音在生產過程中發現的。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA orders fuel tank sealant inspections on certain Boeing 787s over lightning-strike explosion risk
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Federal Aviation Administration has issued an airworthiness directive, published November 2, 2026, ordering inspections of certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9 and 787-10 aircraft. The directive concerns center wing fuel tank sealant installations that lacked evidence of required adhesion testing, an issue Boeing identified during production.

international_aviation.headline: 加航明年不再恢復多倫多—孟買航線，印度航點僅剩德里
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大航空明年將不再恢復多倫多皮爾遜機場（YYZ）至孟買機場的航線，該公司正在調整印度航線布局。這條航線過去經倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）中停，根據航空數據業者睿思譽的資料，航線曾以波音787-8與787-9混合執飛，最近一次營運是在2026年3月。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada will not resume Toronto-Mumbai service as Air India steps in
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada will not resume its service from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) to Mumbai Airport (BOM) next year, as the airline restructures its Indian operations. The service historically operated with a stop at London Heathrow Airport (LHR), and data from Cirium shows it was flown with a mix of the airline's Boeing 787-8 and 787-9 aircraft, most recently in March 2026.
